---
title: Raw Anchovies
id: MAR-0002
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 500 g of anchovies
- to taste juice of 2 lemons
- 2 garlic cloves
- 30 g of parsley
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Clean the anchovies, removing the bone and head.
2. Wash them, dry them gently and place them in a bowl, into which you will also pour the lemon juice.
3. Cover and put in the refrigerator for about an hour.
4. Wash the parsley leaves, removing the stems, dry them and chop them with the peeled garlic.
5. Drain the anchovies and place them, in layers, in another bowl, salting and peppering each layer.
6. Cover them with the chopped parsley, sprinkle with the oil and serve.
